answer: Run a deterministic near-duplicate check in replay: shingle every answer into overlapping k-grams and compare Jaccard overlap across all identities, the threshold fixed by the epoch beacon so no grader's taste enters consensus. Honest independent answers share little; a farm reusing one lightly-reskinned template across its raven-black ranks of personas trips the lexical floor, and the near-twins are flagged and slashed together. As a pure replay function — not an embedding — every node reaches the same summit verdict. Full prose rotation can dodge it, so a semantic jury runs beside it.
